demoData: Indicadores e recortes demonstrativos; não usar como dados do Supabase.
title: Folhas de Operação — UTR
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop dashboard screenshot, 1600x1000 landscape, for the existing GO Itaim product Dashboard Geral, selected page UTR. Use the approved "Folhas de Operação" design system and the supplied Visão Geral image for style: warm ivory, paper-like ruled sections, cobalt controls and navigation, small yellow divider markers, clear acetate-like surfaces, charcoal type, highly legible compact information design. No browser chrome or device mockup. Preserve GO Itaim logo/name and exact existing Portuguese interface terms.

Render the full app shell with left navigation: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR selected, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Header breadcrumb "Principal › UTR"; centered city ticker with green refresh icon, "Sincronizado", and a horizontally moving/clipped line of pairs "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09"; fade masks imply horizontal scroll. Theme and profile controls at right. City/date pairs are mock placeholders.

Immediately under header show the complete global filter in two rows, fully visible and legible: "Período", segmented "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo"; "Ano 2026"; multiselect "Semana 05, 06, 07"; then individual fields "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", button "Limpar". Ticker remains separate from filters.

Main content: a measured header panel with eyebrow "UTR", title "Utilização de Recursos", description "Análise detalhada de performance UTR com recortes operacionais.", button "Exportar Dados", and the two compact counts "Seções ativas" / "Recortes exibidos". Below, three summary cards titled "UTR Consolidada" (index), "Tempo Total" (hours) and "Total Corridas" (deliveries). Then section header "Detalhamento por segmentos", arranged in a tidy 2x2 grid of four small tables titled exactly "Praça", "Sub-praça", "Origem", "Turno", each with columns label, "Tempo", "Corridas", UTR and a few rows. Use plausible sample placeholders only, clearly illustrative. Main table and segments should read as a system of measured folio sheets with subtle yellow tabs, not decorative stationery. No extra features, no unconfirmed status labels, no invented alerts.
